item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:45 HKT 09/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The moderate northeast monsoon will affect the coastal areas of Guangdong today and tomorrow. The replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to bring cool and dry weather to the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 09/01 (Sunday)
Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Cool in the morning. Sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 16 - 21 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
